name: Morningstar

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

signatureAbility:
Soul Link
If Morningstar has less than 1 Captured Souls at the start of a fight, she gains 1.
Morningstar's weapon grants her a link to her Opponent's Soul, allowing her to siphon away a portion of the power from any Fury, Power Gain, or Regeneration Buffs they trigger, reducing their potency by [22.83 - 60]%, and granting her her own Buff.
Fury: +[1,756.74 - 4,200.44] Attack for 15 Seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: A lack of blood provides full immunity to Bleeding.

abilitySections.title: Captured Souls - Passive
content: Over the course of a quest, Morningstar's weapon captures Souls and stores up to 5 of them, empowering both her and itself. Captured Souls travel with them from fight-to-fight.
1 Soul: When struck with a Physical Contact attack, Morningstar has a 50% chance to cause her Opponent to Bleed for [1,963.5] damage over 5 seconds.
2 Souls: Special 1 Triggers Unstoppable for 2.5 seconds.
3 Souls: Special 2 becomes Unblockable.
4 Souls: Gain 1,963.5 Energy Resistance, and 50% Perfect Block chance.
5 Souls: 20% chance on Hit to Regenerate 50% of the Damage done to the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% Chance to trigger a Power Gain granting 5% of Max Power per Captured Soul over 15 seconds. Max: 1 Stack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit of this attack deals [1,079.93] Bonus Energy Damage per Captured Soul. This damage increases with Critical Hits.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit of this attack deals [2,945.25] Bonus Energy Damage per Buff active on the Opponent, when the attack is triggered.
100% chance to Nullify all Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Morningstar begins to pull her Opponent's soul from their body, placing a counter on herself.
Damage to the Opponent increases the counter, Damage to Morningstar reduces it.
If the counter reaches 100 she captures the soul, if it reaches 0 her opponent reclaims their soul.
Morningstar can capture only 1 Soul per fight.
